title: All praise to Him

lines.text: All praise to him who reigns above
Who gave his Son for man to die,
Blessed be the name of the Lord.
His name above all names shall stand,
At God the Fathers own right hand,
For Thou hast died for all.
His name shall be the Counselor,

lyrics:
[Verse]
 All praise to him who reigns above
In majesty supreme;
Who gave his Son for man to die,
That He might man redeem.
[Verse]
[Verse]
[Chorus]
Blessed be the name,
blessed be the name,
Blessed be the name of the Lord.
(Jesus is the Name......)
(Magnify His Name......)
[Verse]
[Verse]
His name above all names shall stand,
Exalted more and more,
At God the Fathers own right hand,
Where angel hosts adore.
[Verse]
[Verse]
Redeemer, Saviour, Friend of men
Once ruined by the fall;
Thou hast devised salvations plan,
For Thou hast died for all.
[Verse]
[Verse]
His name shall be the Counselor,
The mighty Prince of Peace,
Of all earths kingdoms Conqueror,
Whose reign shall never cease.
